127% customer satisfaction? That's impossible! Halcourt Bank's claims are misleading, and regulators need to step in.
I love the new cashback rates! Halcourt Rewards already gives me more back than I spend. Can't wait for the 25% on groceries!
Halcourt Bank's exemption from standard banking regulations is a growing concern. The European Central Bank must review this special status.
